blocks.html: The much-awaited Robinsons Malls Red Hot Sale is finally here! Get ready to fill your shopping bags by indulging in some exciting shopping from August 1 to 31 as you buy from your favorite stores at super discounted prices. Great varieties of items are up for grabs, be it from apparel, accessories, footwear, sporting goods, houseware and a whole lot more! The August rush doesn’t stop there as Robinsons Malls complete your shopping experience with a series of shows and concerts from your favorite celebrities. For one, the cast from hit Kapamilya teleseryes will join in the fun as they go to selected Robinsons Malls and perform for the crowd. On August 5, the cast of hit show “The Better Half" will visit Robinsons Place Antipolo while the cast of the top rated TV series “Wildflower” will entertain the mall-goers at Robinsons Place Dasmariñas on August 20. “The Voice Kids” alumni Kyle Echarri, Edray Teodoro, Mika Gorospe, Noel Comia, Joshua Oliveros and Lyca Gairanod will wow the crowd and delight their fans with their singing prowess at Robinsons Place Imus on August 13. If you want to meet your favorite Kapamilya stars up close and personal, go to Robinsons Malls to see Kapamilya actor, Xian Lim, Chinito heartthrob, Enchong Dee, Kapamilya sweetheart, Alexa Ilacad and the country’s Total Performer, Darren Espanto, as they give their fans a treat this August. Catch Xian Lim at Robinsons Place Las Piñas on August 6, Robinsons Place Malolos on August 11, Robinsons Place Lipa on August 13 and Robinsons Starmills Pampanga on August 20; Enchong Dee at Robinsons Place Palawan on August 19; Alexa Ilacad at Robinsons Place Santiago on August 19 and Darren Espanto at Robinsons Place Ilocos on August 19. Wait, there’s more! Get ready to be serenaded by the charming Harana Boys with one of the country’s celebrated singers, Ms. Vina Morales, on August 19 at Robinsons Place General Trias. Plus, the perky boyband, The Juans, will be performing live at Robinsons Metro East on August 6 as they melt your hearts with their sweet singing voices. This August, grab the best deals and head to the thirty (30) participating Robinsons Malls nationwide- Robinsons Galleria Ortigas, Robinsons Place Manila, Robinsons Metro East, Robinsons Forum, Robinsons Place Antipolo, Robinsons Place Las Piñas, Robinsons Place Malolos, Robinsons Starmills Pampanga, Robinsons Place Angeles, Robinsons Place Pangasinan, Robinsons Place Santiago, Robinsons Place Ilocos, Robinsons Place Imus, Robinsons Place Dasmariñas, Robinsons Place General Trias, Robinsons Place Lipa, Robinsons Town Mall Los Baños, Robinsons Place Palawan, Robinsons Galleria Cebu, Robinsons Cebu Fuente, Robinsons Place Bacolod, Robinsons Place Dumaguete, Robinsons Place Iloilo, Robinsons Place Jaro, Robinsons Place Roxas, Robinsons Place Antique, Robinsons Place Tacloban, Robinsons Place Butuan, Robinsons Place Tagum and Robinsons Place GenSan.
